name: Savannah Lion Tusk
summary: Across the Barrens, Savannah Lion Tusks pass from hunting trophies into Chen Stormstout's legendary ale.

sections.title: A Curious Brewing Ingredient
sections.body: Great cats of the Barrens carry sharp, heavy tusks. Prowlers, huntresses, prides led by patriarchs, and beasts like Humar the Pridelord all bear them. Travelers take the teeth as proof of a successful hunt. In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn uses the tusks with plainstrider kidneys and thunder lizard horns to recreate Chen Stormstout's famous brew. The potent ale has a legendary kick few mortal gullets can withstand.

faq.q: Why does Brewmaster Drohn need Savannah Lion Tusks?
faq.answer: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn uses Savannah Lion Tusks to recreate Chen Stormstout's namesake brew. His mentor passed the recipe down to him, and the tusks are one of three Barrens ingredients needed for the stout's distinct flavor and kick.

faq.q: Which beasts carry Savannah Lion Tusks?
faq.answer: Savannah lion prides across the Barrens carry the tusks. These include Savannah Highmanes, Patriarchs, Matriarchs, Huntresses, Prowlers, and rare beasts like Dishu and Humar the Pridelord.

aliases: why are lion teeth called tusks
faq.answer: Savannah big cats have oversized canine fangs that grow prominent and thick in Kalimdor's rugged wilds. Local hunters and frontiersmen call them tusks.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking the fierce prides across the Barrens tests your skill. Their dangerous fangs can prove deadly in battle and valuable to local brewers.
